learning_outcomes.statement: The learner can define and call functions with the full range of parameter styles (positional, keyword, defaults, *args/**kwargs, positional-only/keyword-only) and correctly predict return values including implicit None and multi-value returns.

The learner can explain and predict the difference between rebinding a parameter and mutating a passed mutable object, avoid the mutable-default-argument trap, and apply the LEGB scope model to explain UnboundLocalError.
